questions.answer: It's best to live in student housing - it's more secure and you get socialized

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It was not very updated, I had to show up physically to the office and wait for them to write down every course on their computer + I had to choose courses from the old course catalogue before I arrived and then upon arrival I had to choose all over again

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: They explained it well at orientation

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Succesful

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Patience

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level was fine considering the language

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The style of teaching was pretty much the same, except teachers didn't use powerpoints as much, which made it hard to understand everything, when French is not my first language. In general, the system is a lot different, I feel like the students weren't very motivated, but there was a broad course catalogue, so you're bound to find something intersting + exchange students could pick before local students

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Cinéma Documentaire et Sciences Sociales
Histoire culturelle et etudes culturelles
Histoire de la télévision
Langue Francaise B2 avancé
Langue et methodologie universitaire

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: The coursed meant for Erasmus-students were very helpful, because you are with other exchange students and you learn the language

questions.answer: I'm not sure

questions.answer: No, didn't succeed in that

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: People are younger at French uni, than Danish uni and they also sleep in class, talk while the teacher is talking... Not all of them of course:)

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The food, the sights, the language

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Speak French well, have patience, choose interesting courses, find cheap housing at either CROUS or CIUP

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: 10 courses each weighing 3 ECTS points is a lot of courses, especially if they're all in French - maybe choose some in English, if you can

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: the time I didn't spend at the university - I made a lot of friends at CIUP

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The language, navigating the French system, waiting weeks for a response to an email
